material_scope: one public BaTiO3 P4mm CIF COD 9014273; synthetic q interpolation only
selection_data: fresh validation split only; old PR26 test is excluded from all choices

fresh_data.split_unit: parent q draw before nuisance and noise draws

methods.B: q parameter MSE plus lambda times expected observed-profile MSE with predicted eta
methods.C: same as B, but detach predicted q only inside the expected-profile auxiliary branch; q remains directly supervised; eta reconstruction path remains differentiable

single_preregistered_change.name: detach_q_in_reconstruction_branch
single_preregistered_change.reason: Validation showed negative grad_q(L_param) versus grad_q(L_recon) cosine in 6/30 V9 batches (including a seed with negative mean), while all 45 simple batches aligned; V9 du-error/zero-shift-error correlation was 0.85-0.95 across seeds. The intervention isolates the q head from reconstruction gradients while retaining the B nuisance reconstruction path.
single_preregistered_change.not_claimed: This is a mechanism diagnostic, not a proven causal explanation or guaranteed improvement.

training.selection_rule: per method and condition, select lambda by minimum mean best-epoch validation normalized q MAE across all three paired seeds; ties select smaller lambda
training.test_rule: evaluate selected A/B/C checkpoints once after all validation-only choices; no retraining or retuning after test

conditions.simple: fixed zero shift and 0.08 degree FWHM; 100-200 count linear background; Poisson counts; max normalization and log1p_100
conditions.v9: zero shift, width, background, Poisson plus Gaussian readout; deterministic background shape; March-Dollase off

evaluation.profile: transformed observed-profile RMSE using both equal neutral-eta profile-fit paths and separately labeled direct predicted-eta paths
evaluation.claim_limit: single CIF conditional interpolation; no real XRD, unseen compositions, or Rietveld claim
